usedFor: Booqable holds rental orders and MailerLite holds your list, so “Reserved Order” can run “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “Completed Payment” in Booqable, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A paid customer joins your list, and an existing subscriber is updated instead of duplicated.

watchOut: “Finalize Invoice” and “Completed Payment” in Booqable both reach “Create or Update Subscriber”, so enable only the events you want.
